findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed no paper towels to be present upon arrival at bar hand sink. Discussed with PIC, paper towels were brought to hand sink. Ensure all hand sinks are properly equipped with soap and paper towels.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; or (C) A heated-air hand drying device; or (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed no sanitizer to be set up upon arrival. Discussed with PIC, sanitizer solution was set up and tested at 200 ppm Quat. Ensure a sanitizer solution is available and prepared during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (A) A chlorine solution shall have a minimum temperature based on the concentration and PH of the solution as listed in the chart in 4-501.114 (A).

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: Observed no quat test strips to be available during facility. Facility is using Quat as sanitizer. Discussed with PIC, Quat test strips will be purchased. Ensure facility has the correct test strips within facility during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.14 Sanitizing Solutions, Testing Devices. A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed mop to be resting in mop bucket. Discussed with PIC, mop was relocated to mop strainer. Ensure mops are stored in a way that prevents any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.14: A sign or poster that notifies FOOD EMPLOYEES to wash their hands shall be provided at all HANDWASHING SINKS used by FOOD EMPLOYEES and shall be clearly visible to FOOD EMPLOYEES. 

Observed all 3 bathrooms and the bar hand sink to lack a hand washing sign. Provided 4 hand washing signs. Discussed with PIC. Employee put up signs. COS.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Observed the pizza grates of both pizza ovens to be soiled with food debris. Discussed with employee. Employee began to wash, rinse, sanitize during the inspection. Ensure staff is aware to routinely clean the pizza grates, not just the tray (trays were clean). COS.

Observed the ice scoop to be sitting on top of the ice machine in the back. Cease practice. Ice scoops should be placed in a bucket or on a tray and not directly on the ice machine. Discussed with PIC. COS.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. 

Observed no quaternary ammonium test strips for the facility. Facility has chlorine bleach test strips. Sanitizer is quat (provided by EcoLab). Discussed with owner. Ensure proper test strips are bought. Provided samples. COS.

findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment:
410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430 (C) Facility is not in compliance with the food handler law. All food handlers, other than someone who has the food service sanitation manager certificate, shall receive or obtain training in basic food handling principles as outlined in Subpart M of the Illinois Food Code. Food handlers working at a temporary food establishment are exempt from this requirement.  

Observed no food handler’s licenses for the facility. Discussed with owner/PIC. Ensure all staff obtains a food handler’s license. Valid for 3 years. Ensure new staff obtains a food handler’s license within 30 days of employment. Correct by next routine inspection.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures. 

On arrival, the hand sink in the bar area was not supplied with paper towels. Towels were supplied during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.11: Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. 

On arrival, no soap was available at the hand sink in the bar area. Multiple bottles of hand sanitizer and hand location were observed in the area. A discussion took place in relation to sanitizer not being an effective replacement for soap/ hand washing. Soap was provided to correct.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. 

On arrival, no test strips were available for checking the concentration of CL based sanitizer solutions in the facility. Test strips acquired during the inspection to correct.
